anchor.statement: Lemma 8.2. Fix a correction stage j, an exponent α , a band, its common torus y = Y i 0 , and e ∈ {0, 1, 2}. Let f ∈ M α be a smooth scalar coefficient. In particular, its smooth zero extension satisfies, for every fixed multi-index I of derivatives in (R, Z, T, y), | ∂ I f| ≤ C j,I ε αS B j,I ∗ ζδ −B j,I. Then T e f is supported in the same active radial shell and in the projection of the input support to (Z, T), and belongs to M α under the primitive normalization just defined. Exactly, D e T e f = f − A e f. (8.7) If ∫︁ R e ⟨f⟩ Y dR = 0 at every (Z, T), then ⟨A e f⟩ Y = 0, and for every fixed I and integer p ≥ 1, | ∂ I A e f| ≤ C j,I,p ε α +p κsS B j,I,p ∗ ζδ −B j,I,p . (8.8) Only finitely many input derivatives are used for each (I, p). Constants and powers may depend on these indices, the stage, and the fixed profile, but not on the band, label, or point. If f is independent of Y and ∫︁ R e f dR = 0 at every slow point, the cutoff remainder is identically zero.

correspondence.note: Split into the exact identity D Ic f = f − (cutoff remainder) in the physical radial variable, preservation of Mα, shell support and fiber locality (support in the (Z,T) projection), the auxiliary mean of the remainder as a multiple of the radial integral of ⟨f⟩Y, membership of the remainder in every class Mβ under zero integral (stronger than (8.8)), and zero remainder for Y-independent sources. The weight Re enters by applying these to Re f (e.g. the weighted source for e = 1) rather than through one statement indexed by e ∈ {0,1,2}.

links.doc:
The exact alias mean is the radial mean mass times its cutoff derivative.
The source need not have zero torus mean at each radius.
links.name: NavierStokes.PressureStream.torusAverage_physicalAlias

conclusion.text:
NavierStokes.PressureStream.torusAverage (NavierStokes.RadialPullback.physicalAlias d a b M (0, v) f) p =
  NavierStokes.RadialPullback.radialJacobian d p.1 *
      deriv (NavierStokes.TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff (a ^ d) (b ^ d))
        (NavierStokes.RadialPullback.powerChart d a p.1) *
    NavierStokes.PressureStream.pressureMass f p.2

exact.text:
∀ {S : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup S] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ S] {d a b M : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a < b →
      0 < d →
        ∀ (v : NavierStokes.PressureStream.Plane) {f : NavierStokes.PressureStream.Lift S → ℝ},
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
            NavierStokes.RadialAlias.RadiallySupported a b f →
              NavierStokes.PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift f →
                ∀ (p : ℝ × S),
                  NavierStokes.PressureStream.torusAverage (NavierStokes.RadialPullback.physicalAlias d a b M (0, v) f)
                      p =
                    NavierStokes.RadialPullback.radialJacobian d p.1 *
                        deriv (NavierStokes.TransportPrimitive.interiorCutoff (a ^ d) (b ^ d))
                          (NavierStokes.RadialPullback.powerChart d a p.1) *
                      NavierStokes.PressureStream.pressureMass f p.2
